text: Stale version pin in README (==3.3.0 vs 3.4.0) reported in #73769, fixed in #73770, approved and merged into main by PMC chair Jarek Potiuk on 2026-09-27.
82 broken image references in the ADS design-system docs (9 dead Notion S3 assets + 73 missing in-repo docs/ images) reported in #42298; taken into the team's internal tracker as APP-16043.

9 dead build-status badges in the README's Official Builds table (HTTP 403 on Google Cloud Storage) and discontinued Bintray link reported in #128150; assigned to Venkat6871 and triaged as type:docs-bug.

2 broken announcement OG-image links in the changelog (caused by the .png to .webp asset rename in 91396071) submitted as #23594; automatically closed under the project's AI policy via agentscan without human review. Reproducible verification chain left in comment for human maintainers.

2 missing in-repo images in vendored package READMEs (internal/ringbuffer/Circular_Buffer_Animation.gif, internal/s3select/jstream/jstream.png) verified 404 at HEAD — not reportable: the repository is archived and read-only. The finding remains in the dataset as historical rot.

Broken image link in architecture/environments/operator.md (references images/operator_render_flow.svg, 404; asset actually lives at operator/images/operator_render_flow.svg) reported in #61944 with a suggested one-line fix.

CNM diagram broken in daemon/libnetwork/docs/design.md (root-relative /docs/cnm-model.jpg → 404 while the image sits next to the document at daemon/libnetwork/docs/cnm-model.jpg, 200) reported in #53789 with a suggested one-line fix.

Both Data Exporter extension screenshots broken by a doubled data-exporter/ path segment in description.md (actual assets live one level up, verified 404/200 pair) reported in #14662 with a two-line fix offer.

Missing BotFather screenshot in the elevenlabs-speech-to-text example README (root-relative /assets/images/cookbooks/… → 404, file exists nowhere in the tree) reported in #50948 with a text-instructions fallback suggestion. The three Croatian/Sinhala README image breaks from the same corpus are separately covered by #50300.
Screenshot referenced in tools/project_template/README.md was deleted in 2021 (#14709) but reference survived (verified 404 at HEAD); reported in #50821.
9 broken image links across two exported blog articles under examples/blog-articles/ (referenced notebook_files/ and images/ directories were never committed to the repo, all 404); reported in #4776.

Two broken image references in dev/snippets/README.md (referenced assets/ directory missing from tree, both URLs 404); reported in #193415, reproduced by a Flutter triager on master — fix offered as PR #193429 (awaiting Google CLA).
Local macOS desktop path committed in markdown (/Users/Hao/Desktop/...), missing res/ images (404), and unresolvable localhost URLs; reported in #1217.
22 broken image paths on author docsite (labuladong.online/algo/images/..., 404 while site root is 200) and missing table_qr2.jpg in repo; reported in #2653.
Follow-up on #1217: the two localhost image URLs exist on the author's public Gitee mirror (verified HTTP 200); minimal two-line fix proposed in #1218.
All 892 CI/deployment status badges on azurequickstartsservice.blob.core.windows.net return HTTP 409 PublicAccessNotPermitted (146 READMEs); reported in #14882.
Author docsite offercome.cn is unreachable entirely (DNS resolves, HTTPS times out): 477 off-repo images dead across docs/md/**; reported in #84.
All 26 off-repo images on author CDN cdn.wenanzhe.com return HTTP 404 (sponsor table and captcha demos across READMEs); reported in #317.
